provisional_claims.summary: Core ecology/calendar fixes: season() offset (day 0 must be Dawn) and weather wetness index; phase() uses 48-day year; neighbor moisture uses start-of-day snapshot; plant comfort uses effective (structure) shade; bare ground regains 1 nutrient/day; species lifespan from guide (glowcap 75); shade cloth shelters tile below too; stress rises only when vitality < 30; worms counted on peat as well as soil; calendar season_day off-by-one; almanac longest dry spell counted drizzle days instead of clear days; calendar plan occurrences counted one extra run; next_weather searched today instead of future days.

provisional_claims.summary: Campaigns: (1) runtime.execution_version ignored the campaign's recorded release and always ran conservation-2; now uses definition.runtime.id. (2) publish fencing accepted stale workers (generation OR owner!=) — now requires generation AND owner match. (3) publish committed state before writing checkpoint in separate transaction — now atomic. (4) compact ignored protected fork origins and deleted lineage checkpoints. (5) fork re-applied events already performed at checkpoint offset (<= instead of <).
provisional_claims.reproduction: Create campaign with --version classic-1 and rain_barrel treatment: results equal conservation-2. Fork at offset 6 with event at offset 6 applies it twice. compact after fork removes lineage checkpoint → provenance fails 'Checkpoint is unavailable'.

provisional_claims.summary: History: (1) replay checkpoint cache keyed only on last event → corrected histories reused stale cached states; key now covers whole prefix. (2) resolved references used author-time local ID bindings instead of the logical entity's current ID, so corrections that renumber objects edited wrong/missing objects. (3) correct() canonicalised numeric IDs in replacements against the final garden instead of the garden at that point in history. (4) rebase used the parent's current head as merge base instead of the fork's recorded base_revision. (5) cherry-pick identity was command content, so independently authored identical actions were merged; now event id. (6) shared-order check ignored the local branch's order.
provisional_claims.reproduction: create; append note A, note B, edit_note B (numeric id 2); correct {A: null} → edit fails/edits wrong note before fix. correct A→A2 returned cached old state before fix.

provisional_claims.summary: field_calibration.estimate: least-squares used uncentered sums (catastrophic cancellation for large/fractional epoch timestamps) and did not average readings sharing a timestamp; now groups same-timestamp readings and uses centered regression.
provisional_claims.reproduction: estimate with timestamps 1.7e9+0.25, +60, +120 moisture 42,44,43 at last timestamp should equal 43.5 (same as for 0,60,120); previously drifted due to cancellation.

provisional_claims.summary: History exchange: _common_bases truncated maximal common ancestors to one (maximal[:1]), so criss-cross reconciliation (both collaborators previously combined the same work) used an incomplete base and resurrected reverted events. Now returns all maximal bases so the virtual merged base is used.
provisional_claims.reproduction: alice & bob publish concurrent changes, both reconcile (criss-cross), alice removes bob's task via correction and publishes, bob adds a note; reconcile the two → bob's removed task reappeared before fix.

provisional_claims.summary: Irrigation: allocate() skipped residual (reverse) arcs so augmenting paths could not reroute flow, delivering less than the maximum permitted by pipe capacities; solve() merged schedules whose census matched even though their gardens differed (lost better futures). Now residual arcs are used and dedupe uses the full world state.
provisional_claims.reproduction: allocate([s->a 1, s->b 1, a->X 1, a->Y 1, b->X 1], 's', {'X':1,'Y':1}, 5) returned total 1; max flow is 2.

provisional_claims.summary: Field courier CRDT fixes: precedes() compared over the wrong clock keys (events dominated by unrelated contexts); event contexts/checkpoint contexts now per-record (record_clock) so sharing one observation does not imply seeing another's edits; _covered used union of all record contexts; project() kept contexts for unselected records (merging a selection deleted other observations); concurrent edit+delete hid the observation (any→all); distinct values casefolded (case-only differences lost); writer-sequence reuse check compared only record; merged packet counter behind its own writer's clock; put aliased caller-owned values; acknowledged() used max instead of min across active devices; default notebook name hashed the whole save (copies diverged); recover() rejects non-text slips; CLI reads packets as UTF-8.
provisional_claims.reproduction: a puts n1,n2; b=merge(new,b,a); a edits n2; merge(b, project(checkpoint(a),['n1'])) lost n2 entirely. c removes n1 while a edits n1 → merge hides n1. put(p,'r',{'text':'A'}) vs concurrent 'a' shows one value. acknowledged({'a':{'a':3},'b':{'a':1}},['a','b'])['a']==3.

provisional_claims.summary: Save merge: _logical_id mapped every record to ["base", id], so records independently created on both replicas with the same local number collided (conflict or silent merge). Now non-inherited ids are keyed by replica origin so they stay separate and get fresh unique ids.

provisional_claims.summary: studies: later stages seeded every treatment from the previous stage's control checkpoint (discarding earlier care); now each treatment continues from its own checkpoint. Stage decision was finalized as soon as any source had complete results (worker completion order could decide promotion, and no-eligible-source failure was never recorded); now waits until all stage trials are terminal.
